methods.what: Expanding a coordinate expression (determinant-like combination) in x, y, z with constants e_1, e_2, e_3
methods.quote: $\left( x(e_1 y - z e_2) + y(e_3 z - e_1 x) + z(x e_2 - e_3 y) \right)\xi\eta$

methods.what: Quadric written as a square minus a product, equivalent to an equation with a square root
methods.quote: $x e_2 - e_3 y + \xi\eta z = 2\sqrt{\xi\eta y(e_3 z - e_1 x)}$

methods.what: Irrational (sum of square roots) form of the surface equation
methods.quote: $\sqrt{\frac{x}{y}(e_2 z - e_1 y)} = \sqrt{(e_1 x - e_3 z)\frac{y}{x}} + \sqrt{\xi\eta z}$

methods.what: Alternative quadric relation of the form square minus 4·product equals zero
methods.quote: $\left( (x e_2 - e_3 y) - \xi\eta z \right)^2 - 4\xi\eta x(e_1 y - e_2 z) = 0$

methods.what: Linear relations with parameters λ, μ among the products z_i z_j
Elimination of the products to give a combination with coefficients in λ, μ
Relation among the products of four quantities and a sum of square roots of pairwise products
Linear forms in the z_i with parameters λ, μ
methods.quote: $z_1 - \lambda z_3 \quad z_2 - \frac{1}{\lambda} z_4 \quad z_5 - \mu z_8 \quad z_6 - \frac{1}{\mu} z_7$
